subject: SIG packaging & manifest crosswalk for NovaWorks procurement portal
messages:
From: Samir Mehta <samir@novaworks.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 11:12:00 -0400
Subject: SIG packaging for procurement - OneTrust/Whistic upload

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the update on SOC 2. Procurement is asking us to submit the SIG questionnaire and supporting evidence into their vendor portal (they use Whistic, and they still accept a OneTrust-style PDF bundle for the legal review team). Can you confirm whether you can: 

- Produce a flattened PDF export of the completed SIG that preserves question/answer framing (not screenshots),
- Generate a simple export manifest (CSV/JSON) mapping each evidence file to SIG control IDs, and
- Upload to Whistic (we will provide portal credentials) or send a OneTrust-ready bundle if their automated upload fails.

They want the files and manifest by EOD Thursday PT. Procurement contact is procurement@novaworks.com if you need to coordinate SFTP/portal access.

Appreciate the help — we are targeting a Q3 go/no-go at NovaWorks, so this is time-sensitive.

Best,
Samir
Head of Cloud Architecture
NovaWorks
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samir Mehta <samir@novaworks.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 12:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: SIG packaging for procurement - OneTrust/Whistic upload

Forwarding Samir's request — procurement needs a SIG bundle + manifest + portal upload by Thu EOD PT. Samir shares the portal creds to the procurement alias.

Quick notes / constraints from our side:
- We have SIG_Answers_v3.pdf (latest with reviewer notes). It's a multi-page PDF with embedded links to Google Drive docs for evidence; procurement needs embedded evidence, not links.
- We can produce: (1) flattened (print-to-PDF) with inline footnotes referencing evidence filenames, (2) a JSON manifest that maps control IDs to evidence filenames, and (3) a Whistic upload via their portal UI provided creds.

Karthik — can you handle the PDF flatten + evidence bake-in? Prefer a two-pass approach:
  1) Generate a print-ready PDF where each SIG question header is repeated on the evidence page it references (so reviewers can see context). Use font embedding and remove external link wrappers.
  2) Produce an export_manifest.json with structure: [{control_id, question_text_snippet, evidence_filename}]. Procurement asked for CSV too; add export_manifest.csv.

Marissa — can you run the portal upload and confirm the Whistic preflight (filename length limits, allowed MIME types)? If Whistic rejects, we fallback to providing a OneTrust-style ZIP with flattened PDFs + manifest and a short upload instruction doc.

I will assemble the evidence_index.xlsx and include short descriptions for attestations (e.g., "S3 bucket policy - public access block enabled").

Cc: Samir — just heads up on our plan; we may need portal session creds for the upload.

Thanks,
Mina
Sr. Security Programs Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2027 09:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: SIG packaging for procurement - OneTrust/Whistic upload

On Wed, Aug 4, 2027 at 09:34 AM Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Karthik — can you handle the PDF flatten + evidence bake-in?

Quick status: started a branch of the SIG export tool to generate the print bundle. Plan:
- Pull SIG_Answers_v3.pdf and expand inline references so that each evidence file is appended directly after the question it supports. That avoids external Drive links.
- Use Ghostscript-based flattening to remove form fields and embed fonts; output will be SIG_Answers_v3_flat.pdf.
- Produce export_manifest.csv and export_manifest.json. Sample rows: CONTROL-5c, "Data retention policy (snippet)", "evidence/retention_policy.pdf"
- Run filename normalization (ASCII only, replace spaces with underscores).

Open question: there are three attachments currently stored only in Drive with very long filenames (>=128 chars). Whistic truncates filenames to 100 chars and sometimes strips extensions on upload. Marissa — when you do the test upload, watch for extension stripping — we'll include an upload mapping that preserves original names in the manifest.

I expect the flattened PDF + manifest + index by EOD Wed PT. Attaching a short checklist (stubbed as attachment reference).

Karthik
Eng, Infrastructure Security
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Mehta <samir@novaworks.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Aug 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG packaging & manifest crosswalk for NovaWorks procurement portal

Hi all — upload complete and confirmation below.

What I did:
- Uploaded SIG_Answers_v3_flat.pdf to the NovaWorks Whistic portal record (record id 98765). Whistic accepted the flattened PDF.
- Uploaded individual evidence files (normalized filenames) and attached the export_manifest.csv as the top-level file. Evidence files are: evidence_retention_policy.pdf, evidence_s3_config.pdf, evidence_incident_runbook.pdf.
- Added an "attachments manifest" note in the portal comments containing the export_manifest.json content (shortened to the first 500 chars due to portal note length limits). Full manifest and evidence_index.xlsx uploaded to our shared Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD_example_nova_sig

Known issue: Whistic flagged CONTROL-7b (third-party change control) as "needs evidence" because their parser didn't match our runbook PDF due to a different section header on page 3. I manually linked the runbook file to CONTROL-7b in the portal UI and added a short comment explaining the crosswalk. Samir — procurement typically wants a short note explaining any manual matches; I added one under the record comments.

Attachments (in thread): SIG_Answers_v3_flat.pdf (attachment), export_manifest.csv (attachment), evidence_index.xlsx (drive link).

Next steps:
- Mina: please confirm the comment language for procurement is sufficient to close the loop.
- Karthik: keep the export_manifest.json in the repo for future automations; I saved a copy in the evidence folder.

Samir — let me know if procurement needs a OneTrust ZIP instead (we can produce a signed ZIP with manifest), but Whistic upload is live.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Security Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
